subject: art-design
title: Colour & Tone: Tints & Shades
welcome_lead: Lighten with white, darken with black — make any colour sing.
meta_desc: KS3 colour: tints, shades, tones and value relationships.
final_note: Tint, tone, shade — three ways to change a colour.

concepts.def: How light or dark a colour is.
Artwork using one colour and its variations.
Middle value between light and dark.

walkthroughs.body_html: Add white to red and you get a tint (pink). Add black to red and you get a shade (maroon). Add grey and you get a tone.
Value is how light or dark a colour reads. Using only tints feels soft and dreamy; only shades feels heavy and dramatic. A full value range gives punchy, readable work.
A monochrome painting uses one hue with its tints, tones and shades. This builds skill in seeing value before adding more colours.
